data.current_description:
To quickly start sending, use the `content` field to provide the text/HTML content for your mail item and provide the `recipients` you want to send your mail item to.

For advanced use cases, you can start sending pre-designed templates instead with the `template` field to `recipients` or a `mailing_list`.

For cases where you generate the entire mail item on your own, you can just provide us the `file` with pre-inserted addresses or the `file` along with `recipients` or a `mailing_list`.

Download `file` examples: [Single letter example](https://api-docs.intelliprint.net/demo_files/single_letter.pdf) or [Multi-letter example (Split by phrase "Dear")](https://api-docs.intelliprint.net/demo_files/multiple_letters.pdf)

>[!tip] 
> Print jobs are not sent out till you set the `confirmed` parameter to `true`.
data.description_suggestion: Creates a new print job for sending letters or postcards. Accepts multiple input methods: `content` (text/HTML) with `recipients`, `template` with `recipients` or `mailing_list`, or pre-formatted `file` with optional `recipients` or `mailing_list`. Returns the created PrintObject with job ID and status. Important: Print jobs are created in draft state and are not sent until `confirmed` is set to `true`. Use `testmode: true` to test without charges or actual mail delivery.
data.reasoning: Description is comprehensive but lacks explicit mention of return value (PrintObject) and the draft state behavior. Added clarity about what is returned and emphasized the draft-to-confirmed workflow for better AI agent understanding of the operation's lifecycle and side effects.
